severityRubric.critical: possible vote secrecy, tally integrity, authentication bypass, or key custody compromise
severityRubric.high: material election workflow compromise without confirmed vote secrecy loss
severityRubric.medium: bounded security issue with compensating control or limited workflow impact

embargoRule: Keep sensitive technical detail private until remediation and owner-approved disclosure.
customerNotificationRule: Notify affected election owner before any public statement when an active election could be affected.
